chunks: They said: 'Should we place our trust in you when only the condemned follow you?'

key_terms.الْأَرْذَلُونَ: The lowly / The humble / The condemned
key_terms.نُؤْمِنُ: We place our trust / We believe

ai.seo_question: What did the believers ask Prophet Muhammad about his followers in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Surah Ash-Shu'ara (26:214), the Quraysh leaders challenge Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) by mocking the low social status of his early companions, whom they dismiss as 'the lowly' (al-arzalun). This verse highlights the socio-political tension in Mecca, where tribal prestige often outweighed spiritual merit, and serves as a divine reassurance that true worth is determined by God, not worldly hierarchy.
